title: feat: add GIMP 3 image generation and editing with BYOP
author: harisrehman155
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #14232

- Adds a standalone GIMP 3 plug-in with browser device authorization and restart-persistent private authorization.
- Loads the authenticated live image catalog, including community models, and drives edit/resolution controls from model capabilities.
- Generates new images or layers and edits an active layer or selection into a new layer without changing the source.
- Keeps network work off the GTK thread and handles expired authorization, insufficient Pollen, network failures, and invalid responses.
- Passes 11 transport/storage tests, production catalog and unattributed-device checks, native GIMP 3.0.4 macOS smoke testing, CI, and CodeQL. A publishable POLLINATIONS_GIMP_APP_KEY remains optional for attribution.

gist.headline: Polli moves into GIMP
gist.blurb: GIMP 3 now has a little Pollinations panel of its own. Sign in from the browser, pick from the live image catalog, and grow fresh generations or edits into new layers without disturbing the original canvas.
gist.summary: Added a standalone GIMP 3 plug-in with browser device authorization, restart-persistent private auth, live including community image-model catalog support, and capability-driven generation, editing, and resolution controls.
gist.impact: GIMP 3 artists can authenticate once, generate images or new layers, and turn an active layer or selection into an edited new layer while keeping the source untouched.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy pixel-art GIMP-style artist desk represents the new standalone plug-in: a retro image editor window shows a canvas with separate glowing layers, a model catalog drawer, and a browser-auth key/token. Polli, wearing a tiny painter's beret, carefully paints a new layer rather than overwriting the flower-filled original; a CRT monitor robot can eagerly hold the layer palette, while code-plants and pixel flowers connect the creative tool to the open community model garden.
